name: LGS 3 (Hubble)
blurb: LGS 3, a transition-type dwarf galaxy in the Local Group, seen by Hubble.
label: lgs3-hubble
story: LGS 3 is a Local Group dwarf galaxy caught between types, a 'transition object' between dwarf spheroidal and dwarf irregular galaxies. Its stars are mostly old and metal-poor, most of them born in one main episode long ago.

claims.text: LGS 3 is a Local Group dwarf galaxy
LGS 3 is a transition object between dwarf spheroidal and dwarf irregular galaxies
Its stellar population is dominated by old, metal-poor stars
Most of its stars formed in one main episode long ago
LGS-3 is also given as Pisces
The LCID study of LGS-3 is based on program 10505
